notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first only - robots.txt (https://masonhome.in/robots.txt) is a standard Shopify robots file, User-agent: * Allow: / with no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow, so tiers a/b/c all permitted; used curl with a browser UA (no block encountered, HTTP-only sufficed). TREE: built from union of (1) rendered mega-menu / mobile menu-drawer markup in the homepage HTML (masonhome.in/, parsed nested <details>/<a> structure with node), (2) sitemap_collections_1.xml (full collection slug list), (3) each candidate collection's own products.json + product_type facets to verify actual product mix per category. QTY: read the theme's 'product-count__text' element on the rendered collection page (e.g. 'N products'/'1 product'); for 3 categories (Velvet Bedspreads, Quilts, Rugs) the count element was absent because the collection is genuinely empty - confirmed via /collections/<slug>/products.json returning {"products":[]}, recorded qty=0 with that evidence. EXCLUDED (present in nav but not recorded): Bathroom Sets, Toilet Brushes, Napkin Holder (hand-towel-stand/napkin-ring-holder products - decorative bath/dining hardware, not textile, not storage-function), Dustbins/Dustbins-1 (waste bins - neither textile nor storage per rules), Tissue Boxes (decorative tissue-box holders, same boundary as decorative bowls/trays), Trays & Baskets (55 products, product_type breakdown shows the collection is majority decorative sofa-armrest/serving/deco trays with only a handful of genuine storage baskets mixed in - primary purpose of the category is decorative, so excluded wholesale per storage.md Sec 23/26 tray boundary) - all other Decor-group items (Artefacts, Fragrances & Candles, Candle Holders, Vases, Games, Accent Trays, Wall Accessories, Lamps & Lighting) are Decorative Home Accessories/Wall Decor/Lighting, out of scope; Furniture group and Plants & Planters group are out of scope entirely; Kitchen & Storage Organisers/Serveware/Drinkware sub-items other than Dining Accessories textiles are Kitchen & Dining, out of scope. DUPLICATES COLLAPSED (identical product sets under two nav-linked URLs, kept once): 'Kitchen Organisers' is linked twice (Storage & Organisers menu and Kitchen & Dining > Kitchen & Storage Organisers menu) to the exact same /collections/kitchen-organisers URL - one row kept. 'Bathroom Organisers' (/collections/bathroom-organisers, Storage & Organisers menu) and 'Bathroom Organisers' (/collections/bathroom-organisers-1, Bath & More menu) verified via products.json to hold the identical 23-product set (same handles) - kept only the Storage & Organisers instance. 'Laundry Basket(s)' (/collections/lawn, Storage & Organisers menu) and 'Laundry Baskets' (/collections/laundry-baskets, Bath & More menu) verified via products.json to hold the identical 16-product set (same handles) - kept only the /collections/laundry-baskets instance. MIXED-CONTENT STORAGE CONFIDENCE: 'Bathroom Organisers' (13/23 products are genuine ACCESSORY ORGANISERS type, remainder decorative trinket/napkin trays and a cutlery holder) and 'Leather Organisers' (28/44 products are genuine ACCESSORY/DESK ORGANISERS or LAUNDRY BASKETS type, remainder serving trays/tissue boxes/dustbins/napkin holder/cutlery holder) are majority-storage collections with a real decorative-item minority - flagged and set to MEDIUM confidence rather than HIGH.
